title: True Bits in a Repeated Prefix
statement: For every natural number $j$, Boolean value $b$, and Boolean list $r$, the number of true entries in the list formed by placing $j$ copies of $b$ before $r$ equals $j$ if $b$ is true, and otherwise equals the number of true entries in $r$.
